scope: Broader open-source CAD peer admission and implementation-ready refinement of the existing SAB transform work.

method.kind: Public primary project documentation and pinned peer-source comparison
method.evidenceBoundary: ProGPU evidence is mutable public documentation, not an inspected source-pinned parser implementation or runtime result. ezdxf evidence is pinned implementation behavior for its reviewed ACIS 21800 profile, not a normative ACIS specification and not proof of this project's transform convention, producer coverage, body placement, or units.

findings.topic: ProGPU SAB description is not an admissible schema or semantic oracle
observed: ProGPU DXF.md describes a netDxf-style document and an AcisSabParser with tagged scanning and a tagless fixed-pointer fallback.
The ProGPU architecture document says ACadSharp owns the active file-format model and the legacy ProGPU.Dxf package remains during migration with older SAT/SAB readers.
The documented four-pointer shell and face fallback conflicts with the pinned ezdxf 21800 profile, which lists five ordered shell references and five ordered face references before orientation flags.
The described SAB projection follows edges to endpoint coordinates and emits line records; it does not demonstrate a valid or closed B-rep.
doesNotEstablish: the behavior of an exact source-pinned ProGPU SAB parser implementation
a conformance run on a version/hash-bound SAB witness
complete graph/schema coverage or valid B-rep semantics
findings.planUse: Classify ProGPU as DISCOVERY_ONLY / NOT_ORACLE. Do not use its tag values, fixed-pointer fallback, or edge rendering as implementation authority or support evidence. Reconsider only after pinning parser source and a hash/version-bound conformance result against independently expected graph and geometry.

findings.topic: Candidate ACIS 21800 transform representation and fail-closed application boundary
observed: The pinned peer reads a transform from a literal string, parses the first 12 numeric values, and reconstructs the omitted fourth matrix column as 0,0,0,1.
Trailing rotation, reflection, scale, and shear tokens are described as kernel hints rather than matrix values.
The peer constructs a Matrix44 from that representation, which establishes its own storage convention only.
doesNotEstablish: a normative ACIS matrix layout or multiplication order
whether this project's 12 values map to the same point/vector convention
whether the matrix is body-local, world-space, or applicable to every producer/version
findings.planUse: For the existing S3.7c owner, retain the exact raw literal and hint tokens first, parse only a well-formed finite candidate matrix as unapplied, and add test-local asymmetric vectors for translation, rotation, non-uniform scale, reflection, shear, point-versus-direction behavior, and composition order before any placement is applied. Keep unit scaling separate and WCS claims false until independently expected placement evidence exists.

existingOwnersOnly: S3.7c rooted SAB projection and transform boundary
nextActions: Keep rooted graph traversal and transform application as separate implementation slices.
Preserve exact transform literal/hints and expose an explicit parse state; do not apply or interpret units yet.
Use fast generated vectors to establish matrix layout, composition, reflection/shear/non-uniform-scale behavior, and point-versus-direction translation.
Only after local generated-vector validation, use one pinned source-native producer witness at the composed checkpoint for expected placement and exact profile admission.
Keep ProGPU discovery-only until exact parser source and independent conformance evidence are available.
Continue locally actionable work regardless of external qualification availability; update the plan and receipt after each implementation item and report progress after committed slices.
